# `compat/interposers/fetch.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/interposers/fetch.js`

interposers/fetch.js — default-deny network egress for guest apps + serving bundled package files. Resolution order: 1. If the ref resolves to a bundled package file (e.g. `fetch('data.json')` or a `.wasm`), serve it directly from the file map — relative paths in a blob-loaded module would otherwise 404 against the OS origin. 2. Same-origin, relative, `blob:` and `data:` requests pass through. 3. Cross-origin requests are blocked unless the profile granted `network.fetch` — preventing a wrapped third-party app from phoning home.
